decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several actual backpacks from the product feed, filtering out non-backpack accessories like stoves and pillows. My consideration set included a mix of budget-friendly daypacks and high-end technical gear. The Osprey Exos 58 is a respected brand but has mixed reviews regarding its suspension system for its high price. The USWE Hajker is quite expensive and very niche for winter sports. I ultimately chose the SHENHU 40L Hiking Daypack because it offers a significant capacity (40L) and solid user ratings for a very affordable price point, making it the most practical value-for-money choice for general hiking and travel.
